title: FNWoS: Fractional Neural Walk-on-Spheres Methods for High-Dimensional PDEs Driven by $α$-stable Lévy Process on Irregular Domains
summary: In this paper, we develop a highly parallel and derivative-free fractional neural walk-on-spheres method (FNWoS) for solving high-dimensional fractional Poisson equations on irregular domains. We first propose a simplified fractional walk-on-spheres (FWoS) scheme that replaces the high-dimensional normalized weight integral with a constant weight and adopts a correspondingly simpler sampling density, substantially reducing per-trajectory cost.
